issue_context.title: migrate the leader election to use v1beta1 Events
issue_context.body:
the leader election code should be emitting events against the v1beta1 Events API. This change also concerns any kubernetes component (such as kube-scheduler or the controller-manager) that uses the `leaderelection` package.

Part of #76674

/kind feature
/sig scalability
/sig instrumentation
/priority important-soon

review_comments:
[2] This shouldn't created here I think, Instead we should re-use  the `stopCh`. 
One way to do it is to add a field to the `kubecontrollerconfig.Config` with the broadcaster and start recording in the `Run` func (under `cmd/kube-controller-manager`). 
You can then access the newly added broadcaster field from the `completedConfig` passed to `Run()`
[1] `LeaderElectionBroadcaster` was created in #78447 to migrate only the scheduler. Now this should be removed and pass the `Recorder` to  `makeLeaderElectionConfig`
